name: Dyn-3D
description: TempoVista is the official implementation of Dyn-3D, a benchmark and training pipeline for 3D spatial reasoning in vision-language models. The release contains frame-selection tools, SFT and Kinematic-GSPO training code, benchmark evaluation scripts, Dyn-3D annotations, and checkpoints for Qwen3-VL and InternVL3.5.
